Nabertherm TOP 160 Kiln

☎︎Call us to speak to one of our kiln expertsLet us help guide you to the right kiln for your needs!(888) 774-2529We are available 8:30 – 5:00 ESTLeave a message after hours with name, number, and the best time for us to call you back.Sheffield Pottery · Since 1946

The Nabertherm TOP 160 is a top-loading electric kiln engineered for reliability, precision, and consistent results — whether you're firing ceramics, pottery, or technical materials. Built with Nabertherm's renowned German engineering, this kiln delivers even heat distribution and accurate temperature control for professional-quality firings every time.

Key Features

  • 160-liter chamber capacity — ideal for medium to large production runs
  • Precise digital temperature control for repeatable results
  • Robust, energy-efficient insulation for faster heat-up and lower operating costs
  • Top-loading design for easy loading and unloading
  • Durable construction built for long-term studio and production use
  • 3 Year Warranty

Ideal For

  • Pottery studios and ceramic artists
  • Educational institutions and craft schools
  • Production potters needing consistent, high-volume firing

Invest in a kiln that works as hard as you do. The Nabertherm TOP 160 is built to last and designed to perform.

 

Controller

  • Controller with touch operation AC590 incl.cone firing assistant

Standard equipment

  • Exclusive use of insulation materials without categorization according to EC Regulation No 1272/2008 (CLP). This explicitly means that alumino silicate wool, also known as “refractory ceramic fiber” (RCF), which is classified and possibly carcinogenic, is not used.
  • NTLog Basic for Nabertherm controller: recording of process data with USB-flash drive
  • Freeware NTGraph for evaluation and documentation of firings using ExcelTM for WindowsTM on the PC
  • Freeware NTEdit for convenient program input via ExcelTM for WindowsTM on the PC
  • Optimized insulation construction for a perfect balance between the best possible energy consumption and short cycle times
  • Controller can be switched to “Solar Mode” to use electricity from PV systems with and without battery
  • MyNabertherm App for online monitoring of the firing on mobile devices for free download
  • Defined application within the constraints of the operating instructions

 

 

INCREDIBLE FEATURES ALL STANDARD!

Kiln Venting Nabertherm Kilns

Nabertherm Kilns include an adjustable air inlet in opening in the kiln bottom for good ventilation and short cooling times. You can use stove pipe to vent out of your building or for the round top-loading kilns, get a Vent-a-Kiln hood type vent system which has the advantage of not only removing the fumes but also some of the waste heat.

During ceramic firing, certain clays and glazes can release gases and vapors that may be harmful if inhaled. For this reason, kiln exhaust should always be safely vented outdoors. We recommend connecting an exhaust pipe directly to the kiln to properly remove fumes. For models up to the N 300/H, a 3.15" (80 mm) diameter zinc-plated steel or stainless steel pipe is suitable. The exhaust pipe must be installed with a continuous upward slope to ensure proper airflow. Good room ventilation is also essential so fresh air can mix with the exhaust gases. For planning purposes, the exhaust piping system should be rated for a maximum temperature of approximately 392°F. 

⚠️ Safety Note: The bypass connection and exhaust piping can become very hot during operation and may cause burns. Any wall ducting must be made from heat-resistant materials. We strongly recommend having a qualified local ventilation company size and install the exhaust system correctly. For Top series models, the exhaust pipe must be connected to the bypass outlet using an upward angled bend, allowing the lid to open freely.

Thanks to Nabertherm’s optimized insulation design and precisely matched bypass system, no additional ventilation system is required to achieve excellent temperature uniformity. The manual air inlet damper allows fresh air to enter the kiln so residual moisture can escape through the bypass system and out through the side exhaust connection. Once the kiln reaches 1112°F, the damper can be closed to ensure consistent firing results and outstanding temperature uniformity.

The Nabertherm TOP 60 is a reliable top-loading kiln with excellent insulation and fast cooldown times. It provides uniform temperature distribution and intuitive controls for consistent firing results. Ideal for hobbyists and small studios.

The Nabertherm TOP 60 is built with three layers of premium 15 mm microporous rear insulation, helping you reach temperature efficiently and reliably every time you fire.

If you’ve ever felt that excitement when opening your kiln and seeing the finished results, you know how important consistency is. Nabertherm top-loading kilns are designed to deliver dependable firings day after day. With an easy-to-use controller, your firing programs are regulated accurately, giving you the confidence to focus on your work instead of worrying about the kiln.

These top loaders aren’t just kilns — they’re a trusted studio partner that supports your creative process and keeps up with your everyday production.

Superior Insulation & Energy Efficiency

Nabertherm top loaders feature high-performance refractory insulation inside the firing chamber, combined with microporous rear insulation that allows you to fire to Cone 10 while keeping energy consumption impressively low.

NABERTHERM N200 KILN
Nabertherm Chamber kilns offer first-class craftsmanship, professional design, long service life and excellent temperature uniformity – these are a few of the reasons our kiln models N100/G to N 660/H are our best sellers to everyone looking for a professional kiln. These furnaces have proven their worth trough the years, firing porcelain, stoneware and annealing glass. You will find these kilns in industry as well as in ceramic workshops, studios, clinics, schools and private homes – practically every place where a rugged, capable of frequent firings and excellent temperature uniformity is required.
Top quality:
Heated from 5 sides: 3 walls, door and the floor
High-quality, free-radiating heating elements mounted on support tubes for longest service life
Long-lasting, heavy-gauge heating elements
Special arrangement of the heating elements for optimal temperature uniformity
Silicon Carbide floor plate protects floor elements and provides a level setting surface
Solid-state power control relays for silent operation (N 100.. - N 300..)
Fast power switching for precise temperature distribution
Long life Platinum-Rhodium Type “S” thermocouple standard
Door safety switch shuts down power to the elements when the door is opened
Multi-layered lining with light weight insulating bricks and microporus insulation for a
cooler shell and low power consumption
Rugged, self-supporting, vaulted arch construction
“Cool-touch” double-walled housing with stainless steel
side panels (N 100.. - N 300..)
Clean, professional design enhances your image
Solid, double-walled door with wear-resistant, precision-made “brick-on-brick” door seal (N 100.. - N 300..)
Adjustable door with clamping wheels for easy, tight sealing and padlock hasp
Environment-friendly, long-life powder-coating of housing
Attractive, durable, environmentally friendly powder-coating
Infinitely adjustable air inlet opening in the floor
Delivery includes pipe connection for connecting an air outlet (80 mm diameter)
GS safety mark for controlled safety, CE
Base included for N 100.. - N 300..
Manual-Zone-Regulation for sophisticated firing solutions as an option.

Chamber Kilns Standard EquipmentElements mounted on support tubes give free radiation of heat, longer element and wall life; optimized element positioning for excellent temperature uniformity
Easy-to-use Nabertherm controller, precise temperature regulation (See page 22 for details)
Handy quick-release locking wheel, door can be secured with padlock
Base for ergonomic loading height included in delivery. Optional: Special height or running on casters
Large, ergonomic door handle
Solid-state relays control the kiln heating. Operating silently and nearly wear-resistant, the solid-state relays switch with short pulses, giving excellent temperature uniformity and fast response times.
Flue in the center-rear section of the ceiling ensures uniform flow of exhaust gasses (roof flap for N 440 and N 660)
Double-walled housing for “Cool-Touch” outer surface with side panels made of textured stainless steel (N 100/G -
N 300/H)
Infinitely adjustable air inlet damper for optimum air supply during firing and reduced cooling time. Automatic control available as an option.
Silicon carbide floor plate protects the floor heating elements. It is easily removed to permit convenient cleaning of the furnace bottom and element maintenance.
We recommend: To achieve a long service life of the brick lining and heating elements, the kiln should not be fired every cycle at its maximum rated temperature. For process temperatures up to 900 °C we recommend models N 100/G - N 660/G. Up to 1230 °C we recommend models N 100 - N 660, and for regular high firing temperatures above 1230 °C we recommend our models N 100/H - N 660/H.

Kiln Venting Nabertherm Kilns

During ceramic firing, certain clays and glazes can release gases and vapors that may be harmful if inhaled. For this reason, kiln exhaust should always be safely vented outdoors. We recommend connecting an exhaust pipe directly to the kiln to properly remove fumes. For models up to the N 300/H, a 3.15" (80 mm) diameter zinc-plated steel or stainless steel pipe is suitable. The exhaust pipe must be installed with a continuous upward slope to ensure proper airflow. Good room ventilation is also essential so fresh air can mix with the exhaust gases. For planning purposes, the exhaust piping system should be rated for a maximum temperature of approximately 392°F. 

⚠️ Safety Note: The bypass connection and exhaust piping can become very hot during operation and may cause burns. Any wall ducting must be made from heat-resistant materials. We strongly recommend having a qualified local ventilation company size and install the exhaust system correctly. For Top series models, the exhaust pipe must be connected to the bypass outlet using an upward angled bend, allowing the lid to open freely.

Thanks to Nabertherm’s optimized insulation design and precisely matched bypass system, no additional ventilation system is required to achieve excellent temperature uniformity. The manual air inlet damper allows fresh air to enter the kiln so residual moisture can escape through the bypass system and out through the side exhaust connection. Once the kiln reaches 1112°F, the damper can be closed to ensure consistent firing results and outstanding temperature uniformity.
